entries.name: lambda_handler
entries.reason: the Lambda entry point every handler module must define (`return app.resolve(event, context)` / `handle_event`); it is the deployed handler string, not a helper

entries.name: _load_secrets
entries.reason: the filtering is already one implementation (plugin_secrets.filter_plugin_secrets); the read-and-evict wrapper stays per base class because the secret-isolation tests patch each module's get_secret / clear_secret_cache / SECRETS_ARN

entries.name: _aggregates_table
entries.reason: per-module optional-table getter that each module's tests patch (None when the Lambda has no AGGREGATES_TABLE)
per-handler required-table getters (ConfigurationError when the env is unset); each is the seam its handler's tests patch, so merging them is a test redesign, not a clean-up
two routes of two Lambdas (GET /scrapers/jobs/<id>, GET /settings/jobs/<id>) that each delegate in one line to shared.assist_jobs
lazy module-cached Cognito clients; the tests of each module patch its own cached client
same shape, different workers: each reads its own TIME_RESERVE_MS (3 min vs 1 min) and its own table env; the tests of each patch them
the projects-table document partition and the jobs-table assist partition happen to share the PROJECT# spelling; different tables
